text:
rachel: quick accessibility audit request for the Dashboard metrics tiles and settings flyout. PR: https://stash/redwood/pr/5173. Main issues: focus order oddness when opening flyout, and a couple of low-contrast labels on the compact tiles.
diego: repro'd. when you open the flyout via keyboard the focus lands on the close button, then jumps to a hidden banner before the first interactive control. looks like we insert a helper node for announcements that isn't aria-hidden.
hannah: I think the helper node was meant to be an aria-live summary. We should keep it, but mark it aria-hidden until the flyout fully opens and then update it with aria-live="polite". Don't leave it focusable.
aria-qa: Also check the logical DOM order vs visual order. VO reads the flyout controls in DOM sequence; if we visually reorder with CSS grid it confuses SR users. Prefer stable DOM order and rearrange visually only when necessary, then use aria-flowto sparingly.
sam: contrast: the small KPI label uses var(--muted-300) on card hover which drops below 4.5:1 at 12px. I prototyped a computed mix to keep tokens intact:```css
.kpi__label {color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-300) 70%, black 20%);} /* boosts contrast */
.kpi:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600); outline-offset: 3px;}
```
rachel: good. prefer color-mix so we avoid changing base tokens. Also add prefers-reduced-motion and ensure focus rings are outlines, not box-shadow.
diego: keyboard flow nit: when tabbing into a tile, arrow keys should move between internal controls (play/pause) and Tab should move out of the tile. We're currently mixing both patterns. Decide one: roving tabindex for arrow nav, otherwise native Tab order.
hannah: agree — implement roving tabindex for the internal control group and expose correct aria-roledescription="tile controls". That will make rotor discovery better.
aria-qa: SR copy: update the live summary to say "3 metrics visible" not just "Metrics". also for sort buttons include aria-pressed state and a descriptive aria-label like "Sort by latency, ascending" so it reads naturally.
sam: added a short unit test plan: 1) keyboard open flyout -> focus lands on first control, 2) Tab moves out of flyout to next page element, 3) VO reads live summary only once on open, 4) KPI label contrast >=4.5:1 at 12px on both themes.
rachel: can someone add a Storybook story called "Dashboard accessibility walkthrough" with keyboard steps and a screenshot diff for the contrast fix? small tasks: diego to fix aria-live toggling and DOM order, sam to add color-mix and focus outlines, aria-qa to run VO/NVDA pass after PR.
diego: will update PR and mark clones aria-hidden during animation. also will ensure helper live node isn't focusable.
hannah: I'll follow up on roving tabindex implementation and write accessibility notes for the pattern.
aria-qa: ETA for testing: today 3pm PT. I'll report back with any blocking findings.
rachel: thanks team! assign to diego/sam/hannah and tag @aria-qa. :white_check_mark:
